authorization_scope: User explicitly approved the recommended page/dependency corrections, congruent pushes/merges, deployment, and live verification. No paid API use or purchases.

baseline.kind: Previously captured final GSC export frozen before release; not newly captured search data
baseline.refresh_attempt: Unavailable: the Dell source was offline and GSC Wizard refused access with payment_required because the subscription had expired. No subscription was purchased.
baseline.limitation: No fresh country/device cohorts or later dates could be queried at release; preserve this limitation when interpreting results.

release_result.instruction: Record observed release identifiers and live acceptance separately after production is ready; merge time is not ship time.

review.day14: Directional review using 14 complete post-release days after data settles; compare matching query/country/device scopes and report absolute counts.
review.day28: Review the first complete 28-day post-release window against the immutable ship-time baseline; report clicks, impressions, CTR, position and composition changes.
review.sparse_results: Keep inconclusive if exposure or counts are too small or composition/seasonality confounds comparison. Three to five first relevant clicks is an operational checkpoint, not statistical proof.
review.monetization: No conversion or revenue claim established by these GSC measurements.
